## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta7

### Finish visual editor color-field cleanup
- Keep the beta6 **Custom areas** and **Colors** grouping, but fix the remaining Home Assistant native color-field overlap visible on dark swatches.
- Move each color name into the native input prefix/start area and leave the floating field label empty, so labels such as `VF-off` and `Gate area` can no longer be drawn over black or dark color samples.
- Preserve the existing native HTML color picker, stored hex values and configuration keys; no migration or behavior change is required.
- Keep the current compact one-column color layout on narrow editor panels.

Scheduler, current-cycle trail, mower rendering and performance behavior are unchanged.
